task.description:
WF-02 Step 3 (TEST-DESIGNER): Write E2E tests for TD-UI-01, TD-UI-02, TD-UI-03.

All tests MUST be Playwright E2E against the real backend (DIRECTIVE T-2 — no mocks).
All verdicts MUST be GUI/screenshot based (DIRECTIVE T-3).

Test spec: web/tests/e2e/tenant-dashboard.e2e.spec.ts (new)

Test 1 — TD-UI-01 (tenant-scoped landing page):
  - Login as platform admin (admin-user in bpm-default realm)
  - Navigate to / or /dashboard
  - Screenshot: page shows tenant display_name in an <h1> or prominent heading
  - Verdict: 'screen shows [display_name] as the page heading'

Test 2 — TD-UI-02 (tenant identity indicator on every page):
  - Same login
  - Navigate to at least 2 different authenticated routes (e.g. /instances, /definitions)
  - Screenshot after each navigation: nav/header shows tenant display_name
  - Check: data-testid='tenant-display-name' visible on each route
  - Verdict: 'tenant name visible in header on every page visited'

Test 3 — TD-UI-02 logout clears indicator:
  - Login, verify tenant name shown
  - Logout
  - Screenshot: login screen, tenant name NOT visible
  - Verdict: 'tenant name cleared from header after logout'

Test 4 — TD-UI-01 unknown workspace fallback:
  - If possible to simulate missing display_name (e.g. new tenant without display_name): show 'Unknown workspace'
  - OR: note as SKIP with explanation if precondition cannot be set up in E2E

Spec doc: tests/specs/TD-UI-01-02-03.md

No error.SkipZigTest (no Zig tests here). Per-test UUID for any created fixtures.
Tests must work against the real running backend with bpm-default realm.

Commit:
  git add -A
  git commit -m 'test(WF02): E2E tests for per-tenant dashboard TD-UI-01/02/03'
  git push origin feature/WF02-tenant-dashboard-20260616

Complete with next_action='Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 3b)'.
acceptance_criteria: Tests use real backend, no mocks
